title: David and Jonathan

questions.question: Who loved David as his own soul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:1 (ESV): “...the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.”

questions.question: What caused Saul to be jealous of David?
options: The women singing “Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands”
questions.correctAnswer: The women singing “Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands”
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:7-8 (ESV): “And the women sang... ‘Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands.’ And Saul was very angry...”

questions.question: What did Saul try to do to David while he played the lyre?
options: Pin him to the wall with a spear
questions.correctAnswer: Pin him to the wall with a spear
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:11 (ESV): “And Saul hurled the spear, for he thought, ‘I will pin David to the wall.’ But David evaded him twice.”

questions.question: Which daughter did Saul offer David first, but gave to another?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:17, 19 (ESV): “Then Saul said to David, ‘Here is my elder daughter Merab...’ But at the time when Merab... should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel...”

questions.question: What was the bride-price for Michal?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:25 (ESV): “...‘The king desires no bride-price except a hundred foreskins of the Philistines...’ via Saul planned to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.”

questions.question: How many foreskins did David actually bring?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:27 (ESV): "...David rose and went, along with his men, and killed two hundred of the Philistines... and gave them in full number to the king..."

questions.question: What gifts did Jonathan give David?
options: His robe, armor, sword, bow, and belt
questions.correctAnswer: His robe, armor, sword, bow, and belt
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:4 (ESV): "And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe... and gave it to David, and his armor, and even his sword and his bow and his belt."

questions.question: Why did Saul want David to be commander of a thousand?
options: To remove him from his presence
questions.correctAnswer: To remove him from his presence
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:13 (ESV): "So Saul removed him from his presence and made him a commander of a thousand..."

questions.question: How did All Israel and Judah feel about David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:16 (ESV): "But all Israel and Judah loved David, for he went out and came in before them."

questions.question: Who was given to Adriel the Meholathite instead of David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:19 (ESV): "...Merab, Saul's daughter... was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife."

questions.question: Saul realized the Lord was with David and that ______ loved him.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:28 (ESV): "But when Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him..."

questions.question: What effect did David's success have on Saul's fear?
options: Saul was even more afraid of David
questions.correctAnswer: Saul was even more afraid of David
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:29 (ESV): "Saul was even more afraid of David. So Saul was David's enemy continually."

questions.question: Saul said to David, "I will give her to you, that she may be a ______ for you."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:21 (ESV): "Saul thought, 'Let me give her to him, that she may be a snare for him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him.'"

questions.question: The women sang to one another as they ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:7 (ESV): "And the women sang to one another as they celebrated..."

questions.question: David behaved himself ______ in all his undertakings.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 18:14 (ESV): "And David had success (behaved wisely) in all his undertakings, for the LORD was with him."

key_verse_text: And David had success in all his undertakings, for the LORD was with him. (ESV)
